rows.reasoning: Pierce voted Nay on HB 1296 (2022), whose operative change is that a person at least eighteen years of age and not otherwise prohibited "is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana." That No puts him against the rung that would "Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit," but a vote against one loosening bill does not show whether he would "Ban civilian firearm ownership," "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms," or "Allow all types of firearms, but require universal background checks on every sale." Ruling out the rungs on the other side is not evidence for any one rung on this side (V4.2), so the row is BLANK direction-only.
